Class DTOVisitor

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.gc06.mesos.dtos.DTOVisitor
Direct Known Subclasses:
GUIDTOVisitor
public abstract class DTOVisitor extends Object
Base visitor allowing UI or logic pieces to hook into specific update events. It's all empty defaults, overridden when needed.
